data.one_liner: A Dart BPE tokeniser for OpenAI models to encode and decode text.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to encode text into token IDs and decode token IDs back to text. Includes model‑specific encodings and utilities to count tokens for API calls.
use_when: You need to count tokens for OpenAI API usage
You want to encode/decode text with the same tokenisation as OpenAI models
You need a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies
avoid_when: You require a full‑featured LLM client rather than just tokenisation
You need GPU‑accelerated tokenisation or Rust‑level performance
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Only handles tokenisation, no higher‑level API client
May be slower than native Rust/Python implementations

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides broader LLM client features including tokenisation
